description: This file defines a Python class 'AndroidManifest' that provides an in-memory representation and manipulation methods for the AndroidManifest.xml file used in Android app development. It includes methods for parsing the manifest, retrieving package names, adding SDK requirements, and extracting instrumentation names.

classes.name: AndroidManifest
classes.description: Represents and manipulates an AndroidManifest.xml file in memory.

methods.name: GetAppPath
methods.description: Returns the directory path where the manifest file is located.

methods.name: GetPackageName
methods.description: Retrieves the package name specified in the manifest.

methods.name: _ParseManifest
methods.description: Parses the AndroidManifest.xml file at the given path.

methods.name: AddUsesSdk
methods.description: Adds or updates the uses-sdk element with a specified minSdkVersion.

methods.name: GetInstrumentationNames
methods.description: Returns a list of instrumentation names declared in the manifest.

methods.name: _GetManifestElement
methods.description: Retrieves the root manifest element from the DOM.

methods.name: _SaveXml
methods.description: Saves the current DOM back to the manifest file.
